answer: A seat may vote only once three sponsors lock dune behind it, and each sponsor forfeits that dune if the seat is later proven a clone. The oasis joins any seats that share a sponsor into one ridge, and the k-th seat in a ridge needs k² dune from each of its sponsors. A newcomer backed by three strangers needs 3 dune in total. An operator who reuses the same three accomplices for 30 clones needs 28,365 dune, all of it at risk of forfeit. Staying out of one ridge means recruiting 90 unrelated sponsors, each willing to stake dune on a seat it cannot vouch for.
